# PolyAI Platform

> PolyAI Platform documentation. Build, deploy, and monitor enterprise voice and chat agents ready for real customer conversations.

- [PolyAI documentation](https://docs.poly.ai/home.md): PolyAI is a self-serve platform for building voice and chat agents — sign up free at studio.poly.ai and start building today.
- [Platform overview](https://docs.poly.ai/platform/introduction.md): PolyAI's Agentic Dialog Platform is a self-serve platform for building voice and chat agents. Sign up free at studio.poly.ai.
- [Agent Studio](https://docs.poly.ai/get-started/introduction.md): Agent Studio is PolyAI's self-serve visual interface for building, deploying, and monitoring voice agents. Sign up at studio.poly.ai.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.poly.ai/get-started/quickstart.md): Sign up self-serve at studio.poly.ai, build your first agent free, and deploy it in minutes.
- [Meet the new Agent Studio](https://docs.poly.ai/get-started/whats-new.md): Agent Studio got a new layout on 24 June 2026. Watch the tour, see what moved, and find your favorite features in their new homes.
- [Wren](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/introduction.md): Build, test, debug, and analyze your agent in natural language, from anywhere in Dialog Studio.
- [A full session, step by step](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/walkthrough.md): One build from first prompt to published Branch, with screenshots from a real session.
- [What Wren can build](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/building.md): Every part of your agent Wren can create and change, and the guardrails around each one.
- [Analyze conversations](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/analyze.md): Ask Wren natural-language questions about your agent's conversations and get answers backed by real transcripts.
- [Automated call review](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/automated-review.md): Let Wren read a stretch of recent calls on its own, find what's going wrong, and draft the fixes.
- [Chats and context](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/chats.md): History, attachments, voice input, web search, and the project context Wren carries into every conversation.
- [Prompting guide](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/prompting.md): Practical patterns for getting consistently good results from Wren, with real prompt examples for building, testing, asking, and analyzing.
- [Wren API](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/api.md): Drive Wren from your own code with a streaming HTTP endpoint.
- [Add Wren to Gemini Enterprise](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/gemini-enterprise.md): Connect Wren to your Gemini Enterprise app, so your team can work on their PolyAI agents from Gemini.
- [Usage and limits](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/usage-and-limits.md): How Wren usage is tracked and what to do when you hit your limit.
- [Self-serve dashboards](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/dashboards/introduction.md): Build and customise your own dashboards on the Analytics page.
- [Custom metrics](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/kpis/introduction.md): Define and manage custom metrics for your agent.
- [PolyScore](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/polyscore.md): An automated 1–5 conversation quality score for voice, messaging, and email.
- [AI Scores](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/ai-scores.md): Score every conversation from 1 to 5 against criteria you write yourself.
- [CSAT surveys](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/csat/introduction.md): Measure customer satisfaction with in-call voice CSAT surveys and webchat CSAT surveys.
- [Managed dashboards](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/dashboards/custom.md): Dashboards that PolyAI builds and maintains for your organisation.
- [Conversations](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/conversations/introduction.md): Inspect individual conversations to debug agent behavior and audit call quality.
- [Review](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/conversations/review.md): Browse, filter, and inspect voice and webchat conversations from a single workspace.
- [Views](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/conversations/views.md): Save filter and column combinations as private pinned tabs to make conversation review repeatable.
- [Annotations](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/conversations/annotations.md): Flag good and bad agent responses, mark factual errors, and capture transcript and Knowledge gaps during review.
- [Diagnosis](https://docs.poly.ai/analytics/conversations/diagnosis.md): Toggle diagnostic layers to inspect tool calls, flows, latency, and topic citations on the Transcription tab.
- [Behavior](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/introduction.md): Set and edit your agent's global rules, model, personality, and fixed greeting line.
- [Agent](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/general/agent.md): Define your agent's personality and role.
- [Rules](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/general/rules.md): Set global rules to control your agent behavior, tone, and compliance.
- [Multi-language](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/language/multilingual.md): Configure your agent to handle conversations in multiple languages from a single project.
- [Language coverage](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/language/language-coverage.md): Languages and models supported across LLM, ASR, and TTS on the PolyAI platform.
- [Translations](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/language/translations.md): Manually override auto-translated content for multilingual agents.
- [Guardrails](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/guardrails/introduction.md): Platform safety guardrails that protect your agent in production, with observability in conversation transcripts.
- [Safety filters](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/guardrails/safety-filters.md): Per-channel content filters that classify user input and agent output across hate, sexual, violence, and self-harm – and always-on jailbreak detection.
- [Model](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/model-use.md): Choose which LLM powers your agent – including PolyAI Raven, our proprietary model family built for conversational AI.
- [Raven](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/raven.md): PolyAI's proprietary LLM family, built for customer service across voice and chat.
- [Bring your own model (BYOM)](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/byom.md): Connect your own LLM endpoint to PolyAI.
- [FAQs](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/introduction.md): Create curated FAQ topics with sample questions, answers, and actions to handle common caller requests.
- [RAG](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/RAG/introduction.md): How retrieval-augmented generation powers topic matching.
- [Actions](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/actions/introduction.md): Guide to setting up actions for SMS, functions, and handoffs
- [Send SMS](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/actions/send-sms.md): Trigger an SMS directly from Managed Topic actions
- [Invoke tool](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/actions/tool-call.md): Invoke a tool (Python function) from a managed-topic action to extend your agent with custom logic.
- [Handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/actions/handoff.md): Trigger call handoffs from Managed Topic actions
- [Sources](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/sources/introduction.md): Manage multiple external knowledge sources (sources) to inform your agent's responses.
- [Variants](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/variants/introduction.md): Manage multi-site configurations for a single agent.
- [CSV imports](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/variants/csv-imports.md): Bulk import and update variants using CSV files
- [Flows](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/introduction.md): Use flows to guide callers through structured, multi-step processes with validation and branching logic.
- [Triggering flows](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/triggering-flows.md): Start flows from FAQs, global functions, or transition functions using conv.goto_flow().
- [Example flow](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/example.md): A complete reservation confirmation flow showing prompts, transitions, and ASR biasing patterns.
- [No-code flows](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/no-code/introduction.md): Build conversational workflows visually using Default steps and entity extraction without Python.
- [Entities](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/no-code/entities.md): Define and validate structured data types like names, dates, and phone numbers in flow steps.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/no-code/quickstart.md): Build your first no-code flow step by step with Default steps and routing.
- [Advanced steps](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/no-code/advanced-steps.md): Enable ASR biasing, DTMF collection, and function references in flow steps for precise control.
- [Transition functions](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/transition-functions.md): Use transition functions to control how your agent moves between steps and flows
- [Flow object](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/object.md): The Flow object controls step transitions and exposes the current step name in a flow.
- [ASR biasing](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/asr-biasing.md): Configure flow steps to improve speech recognition accuracy for structured inputs like codes and names.
- [DTMF](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/dtmf.md): Collect keypad input in flow steps with configurable digit limits, timeouts, and optional recording opt-out.
- [Few-shot prompting](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/few-shot-prompting.md): Guide the LLM with example user inputs and expected agent responses to improve accuracy in flows and topics.
- [Tools](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/introduction.md): Add custom logic and API integrations using Python functions.
- [Create tool](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/how-to-setup.md): Write Python functions with parameters and return values to integrate APIs and business logic.
- [Using tools](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/using-tools-in-knowledge-base.md): Attach functions to FAQs actions to call APIs and perform logic when topics match.
- [Start tool](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/start-tool.md): Initialize conversation state, read SIP headers, and set variant routing before the greeting plays.
- [End tool](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/end-tool.md): Run post-call processing asynchronously after a conversation ends.
- [Variables](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/variables.md): Store and access data across conversation turns using the conv.state object in functions.
- [Return values](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/return-values.md): Control agent behavior with strings, utterances, handoffs, and other return types from functions.
- [Libraries](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/import-library.md): Standard library and pre-installed packages available to functions, including requests, jsonschema, and urllib3.
- [Delay control](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/delay-control.md): Play interim filler phrases while functions execute to keep callers engaged and avoid silence.
- [Tool classes](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes.md): Use Conversation, Voice, and utility classes to manage state and configure TTS providers in functions.
- [Conversation](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/conv-object.md): The Conversation object, its attributes, and methods.
- [Conversation utilities](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/conv-utils.md): Access secrets and helper methods for extracting addresses and other structured data from conv.utils.
- [Conversation API client](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/conv-api.md): Call configured APIs from functions using conv.api with automatic environment and auth handling.
- [Conversation log](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/conv-log.md): Write structured log entries visible in Conversation Review diagnostics using conv.log methods.
- [ASR biasing from functions](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/asr-from-conv.md): Set and clear speech recognition biasing at runtime using conv.set_asr_biasing() for dynamic vocabulary.
- [Disable knowledge topics from functions](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/disable-kb-topics.md): Exclude specific FAQs from RAG retrieval at runtime using conv.disable_kb_topics() based on conversation context.
- [History](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/history.md): Access conversation turn history as UserInput and AgentResponse objects from conv.history.
- [Voice](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/voice.md): Configure TTS providers like ElevenLabs and Cartesia programmatically using voice classes.
- [Agent memory](https://docs.poly.ai/tools/classes/agent-memory.md): Remember information about returning callers across separate conversations using persistent key-value storage.
- [Extend with code](https://docs.poly.ai/extend/introduction.md): Write Python functions to integrate APIs, validate input, and add custom business logic to your agent.
- [Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://docs.poly.ai/extend/adk.md): Python CLI for building, managing, and deploying PolyAI agents locally with a Git-like pull-edit-push workflow.
- [Testing](https://docs.poly.ai/testing/introduction.md): Validate your agent before and after going live with simulation tests and experiments.
- [Simulation tests](https://docs.poly.ai/testing/simulation-tests.md): Author scenario-based tests with assertions, tags, and system actions.
- [Run and review](https://docs.poly.ai/testing/run-and-review.md): Execute simulation tests, inspect results, and organize tests into sets.
- [Experiments](https://docs.poly.ai/testing/experiments.md): Run a Branch against Live on real customer calls, compare how the two perform, and keep the winner.
- [Automate with API](https://docs.poly.ai/testing/ci-automation.md): Gate publishing on simulation test results using the Agents API.
- [Real-time config](https://docs.poly.ai/real-time-config/introduction.md): Let non-technical managers update agent settings without publishing new versions using structured configuration forms.
- [Voice](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/introduction.md): Configure how your agent sounds and how it listens.
- [Voice settings](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/agent.md): Configure your agent's voice, greeting, disclaimer, and style prompt.
- [Handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/handoffs.md): Set up handoff destinations to transfer users to human agents during conversations.
- [Message templates](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/message-templates.md): Send SMS messages from your agent using Twilio for confirmations, links, and follow-ups
- [Number availability & compliance](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/number-availability.md): Country-by-country Twilio number availability, throughput limits, lead times, and regulatory links for 2-way SMS.
- [Audio library](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/audio-library.md): Manage cached audio files to reduce voice latency.
- [Voice library](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/voice-library.md): Browse, preview, and select voices for your agent.
- [Choosing a good voice](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/choosing-a-good-voice.md): Guidelines for selecting the right voice for your agent.
- [Use more than one voice](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/multi-voice.md): Assign multiple voices to simulate a team of agents.
- [Add a voice](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/add-a-new-voice.md)
- [Custom voice](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/custom-voice-request.md): Commission a brand-exclusive custom voice for enterprise accounts.
- [Numbers](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/introduction.md): Connect phone numbers to your agent using PolyAI, Twilio, or outbound calling
- [Buy a number from PolyAI](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/how-to-buy-number.md): Buy a phone number through PolyAI without managing a telephony provider yourself.
- [Phone numbers](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/route-management.md): Add, manage, and track phone numbers used by your agent.
- [Outbound calling](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/outbound-calling.md): Configure outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, and notifications
- [Twilio](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/twilio/introduction.md): Connect your Twilio account to use existing phone numbers and SMS with PolyAI
- [Phone number integration](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/twilio/how-to-integrate-voice.md): Route phone numbers from your own Twilio account to your PolyAI agent.
- [Handoff integration](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/numbers/twilio/how-to-handoff.md): Set up handoff destinations with Twilio
- [Advanced voice settings](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/advanced/call-settings.md): Configure model selection, barge-in, filler phrases, safety filters, keyphrases, transcript corrections, and pronunciation for voice agents.
- [Web Chat](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/web-chat/overview.md): Deploy a webchat version of your agent alongside voice.
- [Messaging Agent Configuration](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/web-chat/chat-configuration.md): Configure LLM, greeting, and safety filters across messaging channels in Agent Studio.
- [Agent Attachments in Web Chat](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/web-chat/agent-attachments.md): Send interactive charts, YouTube videos, and images inline in the web chat widget, so customers get visual answers without leaving the conversation.
- [Disclaimers and privacy policies](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/web-chat/disclaimers-and-privacy-policies.md): Configure the legal disclosures your web chat shows, where they appear, and whether users must accept them before chatting.
- [Web chat localisation](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/web-chat/localisation.md): Localise your web chat widget experience to serve customers in multiple languages.
- [Verified Context Injection](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/web-chat/verified-context-injection.md): Pass verified user context (e.g. signed-in identity) into your web chat agent securely at session start.
- [Multichannel agents](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/multichannel.md): Build agents that work across voice and webchat from a single project.
- [Email](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/email/email.md): Connect your agent to a support email address. The agent answers questions with standard answers and hands everything else to your team with a summary and a suggested reply.
- [Configuring a mailbox](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/email/configuring-a-mailbox.md): Connect a support email address to your agent in Agent Studio: sender address, delivery method, DNS records, signature, testing and activation.
- [Email handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/email/handoff.md): Configure where handed-off emails go, what your team receives, and how to trigger an email handoff from a function.
- [SMS](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/sms-and-rcs/sms.md): Deploy your agent over SMS with the same brain that powers voice and web chat.
- [RCS](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/sms-and-rcs/rcs.md): Deploy your agent over RCS to bring rich, branded messaging to Android and iOS users.
- [SMS & RCS Registration](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/sms-and-rcs/sms-and-rcs-campaign-registration-compliance-requirements-us.md): What US carriers require to register SMS and RCS campaigns, and how to prepare your brand, policies and opt-in flow for a first-time approval.
- [SMS Agent Configuration](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/sms-and-rcs/advanced/sms-agent-configuration.md): Configure your SMS agent's behavior, style, and responses.
- [iOS SDK](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/ios-sdk.md): Embed a PolyAI messaging agent natively in your iOS app with a headless Swift library.
- [Voice calling (iOS SDK)](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/ios-sdk-voice.md): Add live two-way WebRTC voice calls to your iOS app with PolyVoice.
- [Android SDK](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/android-sdk.md): Embed a PolyAI messaging agent natively in your Android app with a headless Kotlin library.
- [Voice calling (Android SDK)](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/android-sdk-voice.md): Add live two-way WebRTC voice calls to your Android app with ai.poly:voice.
- [Integrations](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction.md): Connect PolyAI to your existing platforms: telephony, CRM, payments, and knowledge systems.
- [API integrations](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/api/introduction.md): Define and call external APIs directly from Agent Studio without writing custom HTTP request code.
- [Chat handoff integrations](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/introduction.md): Hand off webchat and SMS conversations from your PolyAI agent to a live agent in your CCaaS or CRM.
- [Salesforce chat handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/salesforce.md): Hand off a webchat or SMS conversation from PolyAI to a Salesforce Service Cloud Messaging agent.
- [Zendesk chat handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/zendesk.md): Hand off a webchat or SMS conversation from PolyAI to a Zendesk Messaging agent.
- [NICE CXone chat handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/nice-cxone.md): Hand off a webchat or SMS conversation from PolyAI to a NICE CXone Digital agent.
- [Amazon Connect chat handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/amazon-connect.md): Hand off a webchat or SMS conversation from PolyAI to an Amazon Connect chat agent.
- [Webex by Cisco chat handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/webex.md): Hand off a webchat or SMS conversation from PolyAI to a Webex Contact Center agent.
- [Genesys Cloud](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/messaging/genesys.md): Connect a Genesys Cloud org to PolyAI Agent Studio via Open Messaging, with handoff routed to an ACD queue.
- [Five9 chat handoff](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/five9.md): Hand off a webchat or SMS conversation from PolyAI to a Five9 agent.
- [Deployments](https://docs.poly.ai/environments-and-versions/introduction.md): How to make changes to your agent and publish the new version to customers.
- [Environments](https://docs.poly.ai/environments-and-versions/environments.md): Configure your Live and test environments.
- [Branches](https://docs.poly.ai/environments-and-versions/branches.md): Everyone works in their own Branch and publishes it when ready. Nobody waits for anyone else.
- [Sub-branches](https://docs.poly.ai/environments-and-versions/sub-branches.md): A team shares one Branch, splits the work into Sub-branches, and publishes everything together.
- [Compare changes](https://docs.poly.ai/environments-and-versions/diffs.md): See what changed between two branches, or between a branch and the state it started from, before you publish.
- [Widgets](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/introduction.md): One unified surface for embedding PolyAI on your website. Pick Phone or Chat as the widget type.
- [Web Calling](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/web-calling.md): A voice widget your visitors click to talk to your agent. End-to-end browser audio, no phone numbers.
- [Configure widget](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/configure.md): Brand your widget, write the copy, set up consent. One editor for Phone and Chat.
- [Install on your site](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/install.md): Embed your widget on your website. Single script tag, live in minutes.
- [Test your widget](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/test.md): Open a hosted preview of your Phone widget and place an end-to-end call before embedding.
- [Share your agent](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/share.md): Three ways to get your voice agent in front of someone: a link, a widget on your site, or a custom trigger via the Web Calling JavaScript API.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.poly.ai/widgets/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose widget issues: rendering, microphone, network, CSP, and call-quality problems.
- [Account](https://docs.poly.ai/settings/introduction.md): Account settings: safety filters, defaults, and admin controls.
- [User management](https://docs.poly.ai/user-management/introduction.md): Control who can access your account, which projects they can open, and what they can change.
- [Role permissions](https://docs.poly.ai/user-management/access-control-scope.md): Reference for account roles, permission levels, and every permission area in Agent Studio.
- [How to add users](https://docs.poly.ai/user-management/invite-users.md): Add users to your account, assign a role, and set project permissions.
- [How to manage users](https://docs.poly.ai/user-management/manage-users.md): Find, edit, delete, and export users. Re-send invitations.
- [Overview](https://docs.poly.ai/secrets/introduction.md): Store API keys and credentials securely in the Secrets Vault.
- [How to create a secret](https://docs.poly.ai/secrets/how-to-setup.md): Create a secret in the Secrets Vault
- [Access control](https://docs.poly.ai/secrets/how-to-access-control.md): Manage which agents can access secrets
- [API keys](https://docs.poly.ai/secrets/api-keys.md): Create and manage API keys for accessing PolyAI's external APIs.
- [Recordings and transcripts](https://docs.poly.ai/call-data/introduction.md): Access call recordings, transcripts, and metadata for compliance, QA, and performance analysis.
- [Studio transcripts](https://docs.poly.ai/call-data/studio-transcripts.md): Access conversation transcripts and recordings directly in Agent Studio for compliance, QA, and analysis.
- [Handoff States](https://docs.poly.ai/call-data/conversations-api/handoff-states.md): Retrieve the handoff state and context written by your agent when a conversation transitions to a live agent.
- [List conversations](https://docs.poly.ai/call-data/conversations-api/list-conversations.md): Retrieve conversation transcripts and metadata programmatically using the Conversations API.
- [AWS S3 integration](https://docs.poly.ai/call-data/s3-to-s3.md): Automatically sync call recordings and transcripts to your S3 bucket for long-term storage and compliance.
- [Compliance](https://docs.poly.ai/legal/compliance.md): Our global standards and certifications for data security and privacy.
- [Training data](https://docs.poly.ai/legal/training-data.md): Information on the datasets used for our proprietary models, PolyAI Raven and Dialog-RSN-1
- [Dialog-RSN-1 overview](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/overview.md): How Dialog-RSN-1 fuses transcription into generation, reasons only when a turn needs it, and where turn-taking and an agent harness fit in.
- [Dialog-RSN-1 quickstart](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/quickstart.md): A walkthrough of how a Dialog-RSN-1 realtime conversation works: the connection, the session, and the shape of a turn, ending in one complete runnable example.
- [Dialog-RSN-1 quickstart for coding agents](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/quickstart-coding-agents.md): Build a Dialog-RSN-1 voice agent with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI: install the Dialog-RSN-1 skill, check your key, then go from a first spoken reply to a live voice agent with tools in three prompts.
- [Prompting Dialog-RSN-1](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-guide.md): What the `instructions` parameter can and can't control: one output per turn, turn-taking, what the model hears from raw audio, tool calling, response style, and fitting the context window.
- [Dialog-RSN-1 prompt cookbook](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-cookbook/introduction.md): Ready-to-adapt `instructions` text, grouped by behavior: waiting for a complete sequence, confirming before a destructive tool call, and shaping how a reply is spoken.
- [Turn-taking recipes](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-cookbook/turn-taking.md): `instructions` text for turn-taking behavior: waiting for a complete sequence, offering a fallback when a caller's stuck, and reacting to sounds a transcript would miss.
- [Tool calling recipes](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-cookbook/tool-calling.md): `instructions` text for tool use: confirming before a destructive call, describing results instead of the tool, and handling a tool that came back with an error.
- [Response style recipes](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-cookbook/response-style.md): `instructions` text for spoken output: saying numbers the way a caller expects, keeping replies short, and tagging a reply with an emotion for your TTS.
- [Grounding recipes](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-cookbook/grounding.md): `instructions` text for recognizing domain-specific names and terms: a roster, a formulary, or any other list of hard nouns ASR only has to get close to.
- [Audio-aware ideas](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/prompt-cookbook/audio-aware.md): Ideas for `instructions` and tools that act on what Dialog-RSN-1 hears beyond the words: a noisy line, a different voice after a security check, the caller's accent, a whispering caller, hold music on an outbound call, and more to try.
- [Evaluating a Dialog-RSN-1 agent](https://docs.poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1/evaluation.md): How to measure a voice agent built on Dialog-RSN-1: what to grade at each seam, which metrics the wire supports, and three harnesses that add one variable at a time.
